rationale: Giving each feature a separate embedding per interacting field (FFM, k=4) instead of one shared embedding per feature (FM, k=16) will improve within-user ranking, because interaction-specific structure (e.g. user_id's affinity toward videos vs toward authors) is more useful than raw embedding width, matching the verified 6-seed result of valid 0.6025 vs FM's 0.6016.

statement: position-bias-aware ranking via time_ms ordering feature
rationale: Adding a within-user-day impression-position feature (derived from time_ms, sorted per user per day) as an extra FFM field captures position/serving bias that varies within a user's impression list, improving valid primary beyond 0.6034. This is a genuinely new signal (not more static item/user IDs, not architecture, not loss) — it was flagged as untried and distinct from the closed static-feature and GBDT directions since it's positional/temporal rather than categorical-ID redundant.
